description: El Nino-enhanced short rains; flooding in low-lying sub-counties.
National doctors' strike (KMPDU), 56 days. Most elective and many emergency services suspended; stable inpatients discharged.
Heavy long rains and flooding nationally; roads to Ndere and Lakeshore cut for several days.
Malaria upsurge following the floods; paediatric ward above 150% of official beds for several weeks.
National transition from NHIF to the Social Health Authority (SHA). Pre-authorisation and claims portal problems; reimbursements slow.
National clinical officers' strike. Casualty and outpatients worst affected.
Oxygen plant breakdown; cylinders borrowed from neighbouring county.
Seasonal malaria peak after the long rains.
Nurses and clinical officers on strike (national dispute; county return-to-work agreement signed 7 September 2026). Wards largely emptied; maternity ran a skeleton service.
